faqs.a: Our apartment is managed by DCM (Davis Construction Management) Inc. 101 Hidden Valley Circle Huntsville, TX 77340. 936-291-6868 (Office) 936-581-0881 (Cell) email: kristy@dcmhuntsville.com
Yes, all one-bedroom apartments are designed with "In Suite" Bathrooms and Our two bedroom apartment comes with separate attached bathrooms to the Bedrooms.

faqs.q: When do the contract start and ends?
faqs.a: The standard term begins in August 3rd weeks and ends on August 2nd week. Alternative days also available - Please contact the leasing office.

faqs.q: Can I pay by Credit Cards?
faqs.a: Yes, Residents can pay online 24 hrs per day, by Credit Card or ACH Electronic Checking. Ark in the Valley also offers automatic payment either by Credit Card or Checking Account - Just fill out one page, one time and payments will be made automatically. Convenience fee applied for Credit Card and Debit Card payments.

faqs.q: What are the policies on pets, smoking, and Guest?
faqs.a: The Ark In the Valley is a pet-friendly community, with some restrictions. All pets must be registered with management and a pet fee and deposit paid; dogs must be kept on leashes when outside. All Indoor areas of Ark in the Valley are smoke-free. Guests are welcome at all times, Overnight guests are welcome with limits on the number of days and guest. Guest parking is limited.

testimonials.headline: What People Say
testimonials.subheadline: Residents love the calm, the commute, and the community — here's what they're sharing.

reviews.name: Maya R.
reviews.quote: I needed somewhere quiet enough to actually study after long lab days. Ark in the Valley is peaceful without feeling isolated — I'm on campus in six minutes, and having internet included in rent was a huge win.

reviews.name: Jordan & Chris T.
reviews.quote: The split layout is perfect for roommates. We each have our own bathroom, the kitchen is legitimately full-size, and maintenance actually shows up when you call. Way less drama than our old mega-complex.

reviews.name: Elena S.
reviews.quote: After two years in a crowded student complex, this place feels like a breath of fresh air. Parking is easy, evenings are calm, and I still get downtown Huntsville in five minutes for dinner with friends.

reviews.name: Marcus W.
reviews.quote: Move-in was smooth, the leasing team answered every question, and the location is clutch — close enough for game days and late-night taco runs, far enough that I'm not hearing every party on campus.

reviews.name: Priya K.
reviews.quote: My golden retriever and I both love it here. Pet-friendly grounds, respectful neighbors, and a quick drive to clinical rotations at the hospital. It genuinely feels like home, not just a lease.

reviews.name: The López Family
reviews.quote: We wanted newer construction without Houston traffic. The apartments are spacious, the neighborhood feels safe, and Huntsville State Park weekends have become our family tradition. Couldn't ask for more.
